title: Provider evidence
rules: Fetch hosted evidence through the configured provider integration.
Persist evidence only through a returned Cadre call.

sections.heading: Read
sections.body: When decision.kind is provider_evidence, use the returned resource or provider integration to collect the required fields.

sections.heading: Write
sections.body: Continue ship or land with evidence inside workflow input, or use returned `review.provider_evidence` and `mutate.record_review` actions.
